ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)
anti_deadlock_rule: Deadlock is prevented by the asymmetric handshake rule: the master must NOT wait for TREADY before asserting TVALID, so the master can always make its data available; the slave is free to wait for TVALID. A live slave eventually asserts TREADY, completing the transfer.

fsm_states_master.name: M_RESET
fsm_states_master.description: ARESETn LOW: master drives TVALID LOW; no transfer may be interpreted as valid.

fsm_states_master.name: M_IDLE
fsm_states_master.description: ARESETn HIGH, no payload to send: TVALID LOW.

fsm_states_master.name: M_VALID
fsm_states_master.description: Master has payload: drives TVALID HIGH with TDATA + qualifiers and holds them stable until TREADY is also HIGH.

fsm_states_master.name: M_XFER
fsm_states_master.description: TVALID and TREADY both HIGH on a rising ACLK edge: the transfer completes; master may present the next beat or return to M_IDLE.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_RESET
fsm_states_slave.description: ARESETn LOW: slave commonly drives TREADY LOW.

fsm_states_slave.name: S_READY
fsm_states_slave.description: Slave can accept a transfer: TREADY HIGH (may be asserted before or after TVALID).

fsm_states_slave.name: S_XFER
fsm_states_slave.description: TVALID and TREADY both HIGH: the slave captures the beat (TDATA + qualifiers).

fsm_hints.trigger: A transfer is triggered by the coincidence of TVALID and TREADY on a rising ACLK edge.
fsm_hints.rule: Once TVALID is asserted it must remain asserted (with stable payload) until the transfer completes; the master must not wait for TREADY before asserting TVALID; the slave may wait for TVALID before TREADY.
fsm_hints.abort: There is no protocol-level abort; a transfer simply stalls while TREADY is LOW (slave backpressure).

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: During reset (ARESETn LOW) the master drives TVALID LOW and the slave commonly drives TREADY LOW. After ARESETn goes HIGH, the master may first assert TVALID on the next rising ACLK edge; transfers then proceed subject to TREADY backpressure.

default_ready_state_recommendation.master_active: TVALID=1 with stable payload until TREADY=1.
default_ready_state_recommendation.slave: TREADY reflects acceptance capacity; may be high by default or gated by buffer space (backpressure).

configurations.name: Point-to-point master->slave
configurations.description: One source streaming to one sink (the base AXI4-Stream connection).

configurations.name: Packetized stream
configurations.description: TLAST-delimited packets; TUSER may mark frame boundaries.

configurations.name: Multiplexed via interconnect
configurations.description: Multiple streams share a channel; TID/TDEST route and order them.

timing_dependency_rule: All AXI4-Stream signals are sampled on the rising edge of the single shared ACLK. A transfer's timing depends only on the coincidence of TVALID and TREADY; there is no latency model, no read/write phase, and no forwarded/embedded clock. TVALID may first assert one ACLK edge after ARESETn is HIGH.
